chunks: "Follow the saying of the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله, for he said: 'Whoever opens upon himself a door of begging, Allah will open upon him a door of poverty.'"

key_terms.رَسُولِ اللَّهِ: the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم
key_terms.مَسْأَلَةٍ: begging or asking people for help

ai.seo_question: What did the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم say about begging and poverty?
ai.summary: Amir al-Mu'minin عليه السلام instructs people to adhere to the teaching of the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم regarding begging. The hadith warns that making begging a habit brings about poverty, emphasizing dignity, restraint, and reliance on lawful means of livelihood.
